test.name: spec 0042 AC-17 mysql survives planned restart

expected: cargo test -p stacklyd --test native_launchd mysql_8_4_survives_planned_restart_and_sigkill_and_returns_after_kickstart_and_bootout mysql_9_7_survives_planned_restart_and_sigkill_and_returns_after_kickstart_and_bootout -- --ignored, run in the launchd gui domain with the MySQL 8.4.11 and 9.7.2 artifacts in the xtask runtime cache, keeps the pid and startedAt of a running MySQL instance of each line through stackly daemon restart and a SIGKILL of stacklyd, so HandoverProof official/mysql line 1 with the ID of that evidence can be added to HANDOVER_PROVEN
reason: the two tests run stacklyd as a LaunchAgent in the launchd gui domain of the user's login session and end that session with launchctl kickstart -k and bootout; the scope 07 rules leave launchd runs to the user, so this tester session (tst-f42-test) did not run them, HANDOVER_PROVEN gets no official/mysql entry, and a MySQL instance takes the stop_restore path on a planned daemon restart. The parts that need no launchd job are covered: official_mysql_has_no_handover_proof_before_its_launchd_records_pass (crates/core/tests/provider_packages.rs) and mysql_8_4_restart_preview_stops_and_restores_while_the_handover_is_unproven and its 9.7 twin (apps/daemon/tests/mysql/handover.rs, cached artifacts only)
steps: on this Mac, logged in to the GUI session, with the MySQL artifacts mysql-8.4.11-macos-aarch64 and mysql-9.7.2-macos-aarch64 in the xtask runtime cache

from a clean HEAD run `cargo xtask evidence run --kind native -- cargo test -p stacklyd --test native_launchd --locked -- --ignored --test-threads 1 mysql_8_4_survives_planned_restart_and_sigkill_and_returns_after_kickstart_and_bootout mysql_9_7_survives_planned_restart_and_sigkill_and_returns_after_kickstart_and_bootout`
expect both tests to pass with the same mysqld pid and startedAt through `stackly daemon restart` and a SIGKILL of stacklyd, and a new mysqld after kickstart -k and bootout

on PASS of both, add HandoverProof::new("official/mysql", "1", "<ID of that evidence>") to HANDOVER_PROVEN in the same commit as the records, and flip official_mysql_has_no_handover_proof_before_its_launchd_records_pass
